mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status = 1 AND ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.sort ASC
SELECT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND rm.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY m.sort ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission != '' AND ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission != '' AND rm.role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT permission FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND type = 'F' AND parent_id = #{parentId} AND permission IS NOT NULL AND permission != ''
